title: Rayna Lai: hover a word in her 'little loves' bio and a cut-out photo pops up
note: Text hover motion inspo + portfolio bio inspo. Rayna Lai (designer at Thinkingbox, prev. product designer at EA) posted 'a couple of my favs~' on 2026-11-26: a serif 'my little loves' list (Finding good eats. My Fujifilm. Making playlists. The Arcane Series. Baking. Pokémon cards. Hojicha oat-milk lattes. Sleeping in. Badminton.). Hovering a phrase darkens it while the rest fades to grey, and a transparent cut-out (a rice bowl, the camera, Arcane characters, a Pokémon pack, a latte, a kitten with a badminton racket) pops in beside it. Portfolio: https://raynalai.com (bio line: 'A designer sparking delight across the digital world through product, brand, and motion.')
